proof_scope: live desktop execution against an already-open Chrome side-panel using calibrated coordinates, plus fail-closed desktop preflight

claims.proves: with calibrated local coordinates, the production submit command can paste into the visible side-panel composer, submit, and produce a screenshot OCR readback containing the requested marker
claims.does_not_prove: that coordinates are portable across displays, that Gemini review quality is high, or that dynamic copy-icon coordinates are stable

what_was_exercised: the production run.sh submit --execute path through xclip and xdotool, followed by a root screenshot and tesseract OCR readback
what_remains_unverified: copy icon automation remains coordinate-sensitive and must be calibrated from a post-response screenshot

cases.name: live-submit-produces-visible-sidebar-response
command: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/mnt/storage12tb/skills/ops-gemini-sidebar/.venv OPS_GEMINI_SIDEBAR_COORDS=/tmp/gemini-coords-live.json OPS_GEMINI_SIDEBAR_DISPLAY=:0 OPS_GEMINI_SIDEBAR_WAIT_SECONDS=18 uv run --project .. python live_sidebar_eval.py

cases.name: missing-display-fails-closed
command: tmp=$(mktemp); printf 'x' > /tmp/ops-gemini-sidebar-prompt.txt; ../run.sh plan --composer-x 1 --composer-y 1 --out "$tmp" >/dev/null; env -u DISPLAY ../run.sh submit --prompt-file /tmp/ops-gemini-sidebar-prompt.txt --coords "$tmp" --execute --json || true
